title: Violet Seed Sanctuary
description: An irregular double-terminated violet seed levitating inside five inward-leaning fractured limestone menhirs on a shared mossy earth bed. A single centre-distance glow fades to deep violet tips; reference: ref_07_violet_crater.

review.notes: Round 1: rejected. Failing: (1) material/style 6: the seed is a smooth low-poly gem with one soft horizontal glow band across its middle; STYLE.md asks violet_energy for mostly emissive saturated flowing filaments with narrow bright cores on a dark violet ground, and there are none (hero, closeup_upper). (2) form_detail 6: large flat triangle facets with no fracture, growth or energy structure; it floats with no visible link to the stones. (3) defects 6: one top facet renders as a blown-out flat white triangle (turn_245, closeup_upper); the standing stones are clean pale rounded blocks like soap, and they stand on a flat brown soil disc with a hard rim, scattered with white pebble dots (closeup_base). Fix: give the seed several emissive filaments that wrap and flow over a dark violet body with narrow bright cores; break its outline with fractured facets; add faint energy threads or a glow link down to the stone ring; fix the white facet; weather and lean the menhirs and bury their feet; blend the soil disc into ground and grass.
